links.surface: الْحاكِم أَبُو عَلِي الحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أحْمَدالْبِيْهَقِيُّ

notes: The report is a first-person account by the last link (Ahmad ibn Isa), who narrates the order from al-Ma'mun
Rule 11: a narrated encounter in which the Imam speaks and acts («فقال علي بن موسى عليه السلام») is in the report; ruling needed on whether he is a link

levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمدالبيهقي

notes: the Imam (فقال علي بن موسى عليه السلام) speaks inside a narrated scene: whether he is the source or only in the scene is not settled (rule 11), so he is not added
أن المأمون أمرني بقتل رجل: Ma'mun is in the scene, not a link
